comment: 降妖记战斗台词模板库（人工维护）。键 = 角色 id，值为 3-5 条 {en, zh}。儿童向、幽默、不吓人；战斗中按序轮换展示。

wukong.en: This word cannot hide from my golden eyes!
wukong.zh: 这词可逃不过俺的火眼金睛！

wukong.en: Read it out loud, then we smash it!
wukong.zh: 大声读出来，然后打扁它！

subodhi.en: Magic needs a calm heart, young monkey.
Answer well, and the secret is yours.
Seventy-two changes start with one word.
subodhi.zh: 七十二变，从记住一个词开始。

chaosdemon.zh: 这些单词就是俺的铠甲！

chaosdemon.en: You will never break my shield of words!
Oh no, my words are falling apart!
chaosdemon.zh: 不好，俺的词都要掉光了！

dragonking.en: Welcome to the Dragon Palace, young hero.
Win this test, and a treasure is yours.
dragonking.zh: 赢下这场试炼，宝贝随你挑。

dragonking.en: My shrimp soldiers are at your service.

monkey-minor.en: King of the monkeys? Prove it!
Catch me if you can read!
The waterfall is super cold, you know.
monkey-minor.zh: 瀑布后面可冷了，你敢进吗？

subodhi-disciple.en: Master is busy. Beat me first!
subodhi-disciple.zh: 师父忙着呢，先过我这关！

subodhi-disciple.en: We sweep the steps AND practice words.
subodhi-disciple.zh: 我们扫地也要练单词哦。

subodhi-disciple.en: Not bad! I will tell Master you are here.

chaosdemon-minion.en: The boss said no monkeys allowed!
My fish fork is sharp... I think.
chaosdemon-minion.zh: 俺的鱼叉很锋利……大概吧。

underworld-clerk.en: Hmm, this name is not in our book yet!
underworld-clerk.zh: 嗯，生死簿上还没你的名字呢！

underworld-clerk.en: Fine, fine, you win this round!

imp.en: Try to hit the right word!
Ouch! I will tell the boss!
